title: Local Optimality and Rigidity of Frobenius Tests for Dense High-Dimensional Covariance Alternatives
abstract: arXiv:2609.27200v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study identity testing for high-dimensional covariance matrices against dense alternatives of unknown direction, with $p/n \to \gamma$. Along a globally positive quadratic precision path, mixing Gaussian alternatives over a Gaussian Orthogonal Ensemble direction yields a contiguous experiment whose log likelihood reduces to the corrected Frobenius statistic; its upper-tail test attains the limiting weighted-power envelope at every fixed strength. Fixing the prior's Frobenius radius perturbs the mixture by only $O(p^{-1/2})$ in total variation, and exact whitening carries the experiment, the statistic, and its null law to any known null covariance. Separately, under a product-coordinate null, feasibility needs only $4+\eta$ moments, plus identical distributions over time when means are estimated; studentization and an exact degrees-of-freedom correction preserve the local power. A stability inequality turns near-envelope attainment i

translated_title: 高维协方差矩阵稠密备择下Frobenius检验的局部最优性与刚性
translated_abstract: 我们研究针对方向未知的稠密备择假设的高维协方差矩阵恒等检验问题，其中 p/n → γ。沿着全局正定的二次精度路径，将高斯备择假设在GOE（高斯正交系综）方向上进行混合，可得到一个相邻实验，其对数似然可归结为修正后的Frobenius统计量；该统计量的上尾检验在每个固定强度下均能达到极限加权功效包络。固定先验的Frobenius半径仅在总变差意义下以 O(p^{-1/2}) 扰动混合分布，且精确白化可将实验、统计量及其零分布推广至任意已知的零假设协方差。另一方面，在乘积坐标零假设下，可行性仅需 4+η 阶矩（当需要估计均值时，还需时间方向上的同分布）；学生化处理与精确的自由度修正可保持局部功效。一个稳定性不等式将接近功效包络的达成性质……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明了修正Frobenius统计量的上尾检验在高维协方差矩阵对方向未知的稠密备择假设的检验中，在多种条件下均能达到局部最优的加权功效包络，并具备理论刚性与稳健性。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes that the upper-tail test based on the corrected Frobenius statistic achieves the locally optimal weighted-power envelope for testing high-dimensional covariance matrices against dense alternatives of unknown direction, with theoretical rigidity and robustness under various conditions.
